scope: Selected substantive author pages recovered from the public I Choose Infinity website, plus one validated original spreadsheet. A complete discovery index is preserved separately.
preservation: HTML payloads and the validated source download are copied unchanged. The manifest distinguishes new original-response-mode recovery from existing cached Wayback replay HTML. Text extractions are separate reading aids. Same-path same-timestamp alternate payloads are logged rather than silently substituted.
coverage: The 399-record CDX index includes pages, assets and different captures. It is not a claim that the complete website, all responses, or embedded media have been recovered. The only 2019 index record is a favicon URL; no substantive 2019 page has been recovered.
